name: mate-record
description: Traces Claude Code sessions to Langfuse, and flags what hurt in a session with /hurt (Spire's fork of the Langfuse plugin)

LANGFUSE_USER_ID.title: User ID
LANGFUSE_USER_ID.description: Optional user identifier attached to every trace (shown as the user in Langfuse). Leave empty to use your Claude login email, or else your git email.

CC_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS.title: Max characters per field
CC_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS.description: Truncate captured inputs/outputs to this many characters

CC_LANGFUSE_SKILL_TAGS.title: Tag traces with skills
CC_LANGFUSE_SKILL_TAGS.description: Add a skill:<name> tag to traces for every skill invoked in the turn

CC_LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_SKILL_CONTENT.title: Capture skill instructions
CC_LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_SKILL_CONTENT.description: Include the injected skill instruction text in the Skill tool span output

CC_LANGFUSE_TRACE_SEED.title: Trace ID seed
CC_LANGFUSE_TRACE_SEED.description: Optional. Derive deterministic trace ids as Langfuse.create_trace_id(seed=f"{seed}:{turn_number}") so external systems can precompute them. Use a unique seed per session (e.g. the --session-id UUID). Leave empty for auto-generated ids.

CC_LANGFUSE_WORK_ITEM_BRANCH_PATTERN.title: Work item branch pattern
CC_LANGFUSE_WORK_ITEM_BRANCH_PATTERN.description: Optional. A regular expression for the git branch; its first group is the work item a trace is tagged with (work-item:<id>) when no tool named one. Example: ^feat/(\d+)- gives 37 for feat/37-plugins-on-trace. Leave empty for no work item from the branch.
